1: Independent execution protocol requested: atlas.acceptance-runner.v1.
2: Plan acceptance/runner.json LAST, alongside the actual programs and README. It must be exactly:
3: {"schema":"atlas.acceptance-runner.v1","result_schema":"atlas.acceptance-result.v1","cases":{"A01":{"args":["--case","{case_id}","--base-url","{base_url}"]}}}.
4: Include EVERY normative acceptance ID once. Each implementation is selected by Atlas from spec.acceptance, never overridden by the binding. Python .py and Node .js/.mjs/.cjs are supported; use only literals and {base_url}, {app_root}, {data_dir}, {case_id} placeholders. Bind each case to precise flags that its real program implements. CLI adapters use app_root (read-only application source); mutable fixtures go in data_dir. Web adapters use the exact base_url. External network is disabled; dependencies must already be supplied by the supported image or program, never assume Python in Node images or browser libraries are installed. Prefer standard-library checks when appropriate; unsupported browser prerequisites must report unavailable, never fake UI success.
5: Every case invocation must perform real positive/negative behavior assertions and emit ONE JSON object to stdout (diagnostics on stderr). Keep the complete result within 64000 characters; truncated results cannot pass:
6: {"schema":"atlas.acceptance-result.v1","case_id":"A01","status":"passed","assertions":[{"id":"behavior-1","passed":true,"detail":"actual action and observation"}]}.
7: Return a nonempty set of genuine assertions, exit nonzero on failure, and use failed or unverified when appropriate. No unconditional pass, heading checks, fixture hardcodes, mocked target, --help-as-pass, or author execution claim. Unknown/missing case flags must fail explicitly. Factor shared setup while keeping per-case execution deterministic. Acceptance programs are frozen independently of the downstream application and must never import its own test verdict or modify the suite.
8: README must document the target adapter, profile/runtime requirements, exact case flags, offline limitations, startup versus behavior evidence, and a root delivery.json example using schema atlas.application-delivery.v1, root '.' or 'app', exact source files and runtime {profile, install:[],build:[],start:[...],port:...} for web or {profile:'cli',install:[],build:[],smoke:[...]} for CLI. Uploaded metadata never supplies test commands. No application implementation is generated in this task.
9: 
10: Host isolation contract: each acceptance program runs directly in an independent Python or Node image, e.g. `python /suite/acceptance/x.py`; its working directory is not guaranteed to be `/suite`, so imports must be based on the program location or another explicit path. `app_root` is the read-only application source. `data_dir` is only the tester's mutable scratch directory at `/state`, never the application's database. The application and tester share only network access. Supported delivery profiles are exactly `python-web`, `node-web`, `static-web`, and `cli`; `web` is invalid. A web acceptance program must exercise the supplied `base_url`. Start commands are literal argv arrays: placeholders such as `{port}` or `{data_dir}` are not interpolated inside an argument. A process-restart acceptance claim needs a concrete adapter contract for launching the same frozen application from `app_root` as a dedicated process, with isolated per-instance scratch, doing real app actions, stopping that process, starting it again, and observing persisted app behavior. A new HTTP client or a database created by the tester does not prove app restart or persistence. A read-only external target that cannot be restarted requires separate external verification and must remain explicitly unverified for restart behavior; never claim a pass for it.

Flask/FastAPI 需安装依赖；Node + IndexedDB/SPA 需 npm/浏览器工具且把数据放在浏览器 profile。二者与离线、可独立验收、单用户本地库的约束冲突，故不采用。\n- 数据文件位于应用 `--data-dir/bookmarks.sqlite3`；验收的每实例隔离目录由测试适配器创建，测试者 `--data-dir` 根目录不是应用数据库。\n- 单用户、本地优先；无认证、无云同步。日常绑定 127.0.0.1；仅隔离验收网络使用 0.0.0.0。\n\n## 数据模型（SQLite）\n\n- `schema_meta(version INTEGER)`：迁移版本单行。启动时在一个事务内创建/升级 schema，v1 建表并写入预置归类；版本演进只通过事务化迁移，不回退、不依赖客户端存储。\n- `categories(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, position INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)`：首启预置「未整理」(is_default=1)、「待购」、「家居改造」、「以后看看」。\n- `bookmarks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT NOT NULL, hostname TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NULL, description TEXT NULL, category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id), favicon_url TEXT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, trashed_at INTEGER NULL)`。\n- 索引：category_id、created_at、hostname；url 不设唯一索引。P1/F14 的重复检测由服务层查询活动记录完成；P0 不启用重复拒绝。\n- trashed_at 为 NULL 表示活动记录；非 NULL 为软删除。默认列表与计数只统计 trashed_at IS NULL；恢复清空 trashed_at。删除归类在单一事务内把该归类下的活动记录与软删除记录都改到默认归类，因此恢复不会产生无归类记录。\n- 排序固定为 created_at DESC、id ASC；category 与 q 只作请求参数，不落库。\n\n## URL 策略\n\n- 记录 URL 必须是绝对、可解析的 HTTP(S) URL，且 hostname 有效且非空。单标签主机（如 http://localhost）与 IP 字面量均有效；不做 DNS 查询、可达性检查或目标页抓取。\n- 保存与打开都保留用户提交的原始字符串（不补斜杠、不改大小写、不重写路径）；hostname 由解析结果派生。若 PATCH 更新 URL，必须用新 URL 重新派生 hostname。\n- 拒绝：缺少 /go 302。\n\n## API、错误与状态合同\n\n- `GET /api/health` → 200 JSON，含就绪与 schema 版本。\n- `GET /api/categories` → 200 数组，每项 id、name、count、is_default；count 只计活动记录。\n- `POST /api/categories` name → 201；重名 409 Flask/FastAPI 需安装依赖；Node + IndexedDB/SPA 需 npm/浏览器工具且把数据放在浏览器 profile。二者与离线、可独立验收、单用户本地库的约束冲突，故不采用。\n- 数据文件位于应用 `--data-dir/bookmarks.sqlite3`；验收的每实例隔离目录由测试适配器创建，测试者 `--data-dir` 根目录不是应用数据库。\n- 单用户、本地优先；无认证、无云同步。日常绑定 127.0.0.1；仅隔离验收网络使用 0.0.0.0。\n\n## 数据模型（SQLite）\n\n- `schema_meta(version INTEGER)`：迁移版本单行。启动时在一个事务内创建/升级 schema，v1 建表并写入预置归类；版本演进只通过事务化迁移，不回退、不依赖客户端存储。\n- `categories(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, position INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)`：首启预置「未整理」(is_default=1)、「待购」、「家居改造」、「以后看看」。\n- `bookmarks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT NOT NULL, hostname TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NULL, description TEXT NULL, category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id), favicon_url TEXT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, trashed_at INTEGER NULL)`。\n- 索引：category_id、created_at、hostname；url 不设唯一索引。P1/F14 的重复检测由服务层查询活动记录完成；P0 不启用重复拒绝。\n- trashed_at 为 NULL 表示活动记录；非 NULL 为软删除。默认列表与计数只统计 trashed_at IS NULL；恢复清空 trashed_at。删除归类在单一事务内把该归类下的活动记录与软删除记录都改到默认归类，因此恢复不会产生无归类记录。\n- 排序固定为 created_at DESC、id ASC；category 与 q 只作请求参数，不落库。\n\n## URL 策略\n\n- 记录 URL 必须是绝对、可解析的 HTTP(S) URL，且 hostname 有效且非空。单标签主机（如 http://localhost）与 IP 字面量均有效；不做 DNS 查询、可达性检查或目标页抓取。\n- 保存与打开都保留用户提交的原始字符串（不补斜杠、不改大小写、不重写路径）；hostname 由解析结果派生。若 PATCH 更新 URL，必须用新 URL 重新派生 hostname。\n- 拒绝：缺少 scheme、非 http/https、缺少/非法 hostname、无法解析的字符串；返回 400 invalid_url 且不写入。\n- 上游 S04 的点域名正则与 S08 getHostname 是源观察，映射为 adjusted：点不是通用 URL 有效性要求；target 采用上述解析策略。\n- 保存、打开、抓取三者分离：P0 保存与列表均不请求目标页；打开只产生浏览器导航或 /go 302。\n\n## API、错误与状态合同\n\n- `GET /api/health` → 200 JSON，含就绪与 schema 版本。\n- `GET /api/categories` → 200 数组，每项 id、name、count、is_default；count 只计活动记录。\n- `POST /api/categories` name → 201；重名 409 151: 
152: - 验收环境外部网络禁用；套件只访问 `--base-url` 的精确 origin 或自己启动的隔离实例。不会抓取已保存 URL、元数据或 favicon。`GET /go/{id}` 明确不跟随重定向，只读取 302 的 Location。

155: - 第三方元数据/图标增强端点的实际可达性未经本套件验证；不得把 A13 解释为这些端点可用。
156: - 不驱动浏览器库，不做 DOM/JS 渲染、截图或图标准确性检查。任何浏览器专属前提不可用时，执行者应报告 `unverified` 或 `failed`，绝不伪造 UI 通过。
157: - 不设未经验证的时延、吞吐或成本目标。
158: 
159: ## 9. 根 `delivery.json` 示例
160: 
161: 将 `delivery.json` 放在交付源码根（`root` 为 `.`，启动路径相对该根）：
162: 
163: ```json
164: {
165:   "schema": "atlas.application-delivery.v1",
166:   "root": ".",
167:   "runtime": {
168:     "profile": "python-web",
169:     "install": [],
170:     "build": [],
171:     "start": ["python3", "app/serve.py", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--data-dir", "/state/app-data"],
172:     "port": 8000
173:   }
174: }

176: 
177: - `profile` 固定为 `python-web`；`install`、`build` 均为空，表示不运行 pip/npm 或构建步骤。
178: - `start` 是字面 argv 数组，占位符如 `{port}`、`{data_dir}` 不会在参数内插值；上例等价启动命令为 `python3 app/serve.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --data-dir /state/app-data`。

180: - `/state/app-data` 是交付进程自己的持久化目录；验收调用中的 `--data-dir` 是测试者草稿根，二者角色不同，不要混用。

3: 本目录是一套独立、冻结的验收套件，用真实 HTTP 目标验证 python-web 应用。它不包含应用实现，不导入应用代码，也不读取应用自己的测试判定；本文档只是运行说明，不代表任何用例已经执行或通过。
4: 
5: ## 1. 目标适配器
6: 
7: | 参数 | 适用范围 | 用途 |
8: | --- | --- | --- |
9: | `--base-url` | A01–A15（全部） | 已部署 python-web 实例的 http/https 根 URL；所有 base_url 行为断言都发往该 origin。 |
10: | `--app-root` | A01、A05、A09 | 只读应用源码根；必须包含 `app/serve.py`，用于启动同一冻结应用的隔离实例。 |
11: | `--data-dir` | A01、A05、A09、A14 | 测试者可变草稿根；重启适配器在其 `instances/` 下创建每实例目录；A14 在此生成导入 HTML。 |
12: 
13: ### 1.1 `--base-url`
14: 
15: - 示例：`http://127.0.0.1:8000`。必须是 http 或 https；不要包含用户名、口令、查询串或片段。
16: - 验收目标声明无认证；套件不会把凭据放入 URL、请求头、日志或 fixtures。
17: - 每个请求都绑定到该精确 origin（scheme、hostname、port），不会放行任意 loopback 主机或端口。
18: 
19: ### 1.2 `--app-root`、`--data-dir` 与每实例隔离
20: 
21: - `--app-root` 是只读源码，必须存在 `<app_root>/app/serve.py`。套件只读取和启动它，不修改它，也不读取应用的自测判定。
22: - `--data-dir` 只是测试者的草稿根目录，必须可写，且不得等于 `--app-root` 或 `/`。
23: - `launch_app` 在 `<data_dir>/instances/` 下创建 `<uuid>/`，并把该子目录作为应用 `--data-dir`。应用数据库（如 `bookmarks.sqlite3`）位于实例子目录内；宿主 `<data_dir>` 根目录绝不作为应用数据库。
24: - 需要重启的用例复用第一次的实例子目录；日志写到 `<data_dir>/instances/<uuid>/logs/app-*.log`。
25: - A14 在 `<data_dir>` 根写入 `import-<token>.html`，仅作为 `/api/import` 的输入；它不是数据库，也不代表目标响应。
26: 
27: ### 1.3 重启持久化适配器
28: 
29: A01、A05、A09 使用以下真实进程适配器（cwd 为 `app_root`）：
30: 
31: `[当前 Python 解释器 (sys.executable), "<app_root>/app/serve.py", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "<free_port()>", "--data-dir", "<data_dir>/instances/<uuid>"]`
32: 
33: - 启动时移除代理环境变量，stdout/stderr 写入实例日志；轮询 `GET /api/health`，仅当返回 200 且 JSON 对象时视为就绪（默认 30 秒）。
34: - 对隔离实例执行真实创建/移动/删除等动作，然后 `stop_app`（SIGTERM，超时后 SIGKILL），再以相同实例子目录启动同一冻结应用，读回并断言行为。
35: - 该重启证据只证明从 `app_root` 启动的隔离实例可持久化，不证明 `--base-url` 指向的已部署实例可重启。若外部目标只读且不可重启，重启部分必须显式报告未验证或失败，不能以健康检查或新进程替代。
36: 
37: ## 2. 运行时要求与依赖
38: 
39: - 交付 profile：`python-web`。
40: - Python 3.12；仅使用标准库（`http.server`、`sqlite3`、`urllib`、`json`、`html.parser` 等）。
41: - `install` 为空：不执行 `pip`，不访问包索引；`requirements.txt` 声明无第三方包。
42: - `build` 为空：无 npm、Node、Playwright、浏览器库、前端构建或截图步骤。
43: - 每个程序用 `os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))` 自举 `sys.path`，不依赖工作目录。下面的示例假定套件位于 `/suite/acceptance`；若实际路径不同，只替换路径，不要改变参数。
44: - 目标不需要认证；`HttpClient` 不附加全局凭据头，并拒绝 `Authorization`/`Proxy-Authorization`。若目标要求认证（例如健康检查 401/403），程序按基础设施未就绪显式失败，不实现登录适配器，不跳过或伪造通过；错误输出会对 URL 中的凭据和敏感查询参数做脱敏。

129: ## 6. 启动证据与行为证据
130: 
131: - 启动证据只回答“进程是否起来并暴露健康接口”：`/api/health` 返回 200 JSON；启动日志可用于诊断。它不证明保存、检索、重启或错误合同。
132: - 行为证据来自真实 HTTP 请求：唯一 token、精确状态码、结构化错误码、读回字段、相对计数、隔离实例的前后对比。A14 的导入 HTML 只是请求输入，不是 mock 响应。
133: - 重启证据来自同一实例子目录上的真实动作、停止、再启动与读回；健康检查本身不算重启证明。
134: - `GET /` 的 HTML 检查是对服务端响应文本的检查，不是浏览器 DOM/JavaScript 渲染；套件不驱动浏览器。
135: - 不以 `--help`、进程退出码 0、日志文字或作者声明作为通过依据；仅使用 stdout 的结果 JSON。
136: 
137: ## 7. 结果 schema 与退出码
138: 
139: stdout 只输出一个 `atlas.acceptance-result.v1` JSON 对象；诊断和逐条断言日志走 stderr。示例：
140: 
141: ```json
142: {"schema":"atlas.acceptance-result.v1","case_id":"A01","status":"passed","assertions":[{"id":"a01-health-status","passed":true,"detail":"GET /api/health -> HTTP 200"}]}
143: ```
144: 
145: - `status` 为 `passed`、`failed` 或 `unverified`；只有非空断言全部通过才是 `passed`。
146: - 退出码：`0` 当且仅当 `status=passed`；任一断言失败、基础设施错误或未验证均非零。不要只读取退出码或 stderr 来判断成功。
147: - 结果总长度保持在 64000 字符以内；`common.emit_result` 会压缩过长的 detail，runner 不应截断 stdout。
148: - 缺少/未知 `--case`、缺少必需 flags、非法 `--base-url` 会显式非零退出；把有效 case 传给未实现该 case 的程序会产生 `dispatch` 失败结果并非零退出。
149: 
150: ## 8. 离线限制与未验证能力
151: 
152: - 验收环境外部网络禁用；套件只访问 `--base-url` 的精确 origin 或自己启动的隔离实例。不会抓取已保存 URL、元数据或 favicon。`GET /go/{id}` 明确不跟随重定向，只读取 302 的 Location。
153: - 传输边界关闭代理，并对重定向逐跳校验 origin；跨源重定向直接失败，不会回退为任意 loopback 放行。A14 使用 `.atlas-acceptance.example` 合成 URL，套件不会请求这些 URL。
154: - A13 只在离线条件下验证保存成功、hostname 派生、title 的缺失/字符串降级、favicon 缺失/内联/同源，以及服务端 HTML 不引用外部资源；不验证真实 favicon 图像、第三方抓取、视觉准确度或 CORS。
155: - 第三方元数据/图标增强端点的实际可达性未经本套件验证；不得把 A13 解释为这些端点可用。
156: - 不驱动浏览器库，不做 DOM/JS 渲染、截图或图标准确性检查。任何浏览器专属前提不可用时，执行者应报告 `unverified` 或 `failed`，绝不伪造 UI 通过。
157: - 不设未经验证的时延、吞吐或成本目标。
158: 
159: ## 9. 根 `delivery.json` 示例
160: 
161: 将 `delivery.json` 放在交付源码根（`root` 为 `.`，启动路径相对该根）：
162: 
163: ```json
164: {
165:   "schema": "atlas.application-delivery.v1",
166:   "root": ".",
167:   "runtime": {
168:     "profile": "python-web",
169:     "install": [],
170:     "build": [],
171:     "start": ["python3", "app/serve.py", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--data-dir", "/state/app-data"],
172:     "port": 8000
173:   }
174: }
175: ```
176: 
177: - `profile` 固定为 `python-web`；`install`、`build` 均为空，表示不运行 pip/npm 或构建步骤。
178: - `start` 是字面 argv 数组，占位符如 `{port}`、`{data_dir}` 不会在参数内插值；上例等价启动命令为 `python3 app/serve.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --data-dir /state/app-data`。
179: - `port` 必须与 start 中显式端口 `8000` 一致。
180: - `/state/app-data` 是交付进程自己的持久化目录；验收调用中的 `--data-dir` 是测试者草稿根，二者角色不同，不要混用。

807: def _fit_result(result: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
808:     text = _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
809:     while len(text.encode('utf-8')) > 60000:
810:         changed = False
811:         for item in result['assertions']:
812:             detail = item['detail']
813:             if len(detail) > 40:
814:                 item['detail'] = detail[:max(40, len(detail) // 2)]
815:                 changed = True
816:         if not changed:
817:             for item in result['assertions']:
818:                 if len(item['id']) > 24:
819:                     item['id'] = item['id'][:24]
820:                     changed = True
821:         if not changed:
822:             break
823:         text = _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
824:     while len(text.encode('utf-8')) > 60000 and len(result['assertions']) > 1:
825:         result['assertions'].pop()
826:         text = _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))

830: def emit_result(case_id: str, assertions: Any, status: str | None = None) -> int:
831:     if case_id is None or not str(case_id).strip():
832:         raise ValueError('case_id 不能为空')
833:     case_text = _redact_text(case_id, 120).strip()
834:     items = _normalize_assertions(assertions)
835:     has_failure = any(not item['passed'] for item in items)
836:     if status is None:
837:         final_status = 'failed' if has_failure or not items else 'passed'
838:     else:
839:         if status not in ('passed', 'failed', 'unverified'):
840:             raise ValueError('status 只能是 passed、failed 或 unverified')
841:         final_status = status
842:         if has_failure:
843:             final_status = 'failed'
844:         elif not items and final_status == 'passed':
845:             final_status = 'failed'
846:     result = {
847:         'schema': RESULT_SCHEMA,
848:         'case_id': case_text,
849:         'status': final_status,
850:         'assertions': items,
851:     }
852:     text = _fit_result(result)
853:     payload = (text + chr(10)).encode('utf-8')
854:     buffer = getattr(sys.stdout, 'buffer', None)
855:     if buffer is not None:
856:         buffer.write(payload)
857:         buffer.flush()
858:     else:
859:         sys.stdout.write(text + chr(10))
860:         sys.stdout.flush()
861:     failures = [item['id'] for item in items if not item['passed']]
862:     if failures:
863:         failure_text = ', '.join(failures)
864:         print(f'[atlas] {case_text}: {final_status}; 失败断言: {failure_text}', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
865:     else:
866:         print(f'[atlas] {case_text}: {final_status}; 断言 {len(items)} 条', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

63: def _redact_url(url: Any) -> str:
64:     try:
65:         parts = urlsplit(str(url))
66:     except (TypeError, ValueError):
67:         return '<invalid-url>'
68:     try:
69:         port = parts.port
70:     except ValueError:
71:         port = None
72:     if parts.username is not None or parts.password is not None:
73:         host = parts.hostname or ''
74:         if ':' in host and not host.startswith('['):
75:             host = f'[{host}]'
76:         netloc = host
77:         if port is not None:
78:             netloc = f'{netloc}:{port}'
79:     else:
80:         netloc = parts.netloc
81:     query = []
82:     for key, value in parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True):
83:         if key.lower() in _SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS:
84:             query.append((key, '***'))
85:         else:
86:             query.append((key, value))
87:     return urlunsplit((
88:         parts.scheme,
89:         netloc,
90:         parts.path,
91:         urlencode(query, doseq=True) if query else '',
92:         parts.fragment,
93:     ))

105:     parts = urlsplit(url)

109:     if not parts.hostname:

111:     if parts.username is not None or parts.password is not None:

113:     try:

115:     except ValueError as exc:
116:         raise ValueError('端口无效') from exc
117:     if port is None:

119:     return (scheme, parts.hostname.lower(), port)

149:     if field is None or field == '' or field == '$':
150:         parts: list[str] = []
151:     elif isinstance(field, (list, tuple)):
152:         parts = [str(part) for part in field]
153:     else:

156:             parts = [part.replace('~1', '/').replace('~0', '~') for part in text.split('/')[1:]]
157:         else:
158:             parts = text.split('.')
159:     current = value
160:     for part in parts:
161:         if isinstance(current, Mapping):
162:             if part not in current:

165:         elif isinstance(current, list):

169:                 return False, None
170:             if index < 0:
171:                 index += len(current)
172:             if index < 0 or index >= len(current):
173:                 return False, None
174:             current = current[index]
175:         else:
176:             return False, None

272:     def _build_url(self, path: Any, params: Any) -> str:
273:         text = '' if path is None else str(path)
274:         parts = urlsplit(text)
275:         if parts.scheme:
276:             if parts.scheme.lower() not in ('http', 'https'):
277:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝非 http/https URL：{_redact_url(text)}')
278:             try:
279:                 absolute_origin = _origin(text)
280:             except ValueError as exc:
281:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝无效 URL：{_redact_url(text)}') from exc
282:             if absolute_origin != self.origin:
283:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝访问目标以外的 URL：{_redact_url(text)}')
284:             url = text
285:         elif parts.netloc:
286:             raise ExternalNavigationBlocked('拒绝协议相对 URL')
287:         elif text.startswith('?'):
288:             url = self.base_url + text
289:         elif text.startswith('/'):
290:             url = self.base_url + text
291:         elif text:
292:             url = self.base_url + '/' + text
293:         else:
294:             url = self.base_url
295:         final = urlsplit(url)
296:         query = final.query
297:         if params:
298:             pairs = parse_qsl(query, keep_blank_values=True)
299:             if isinstance(params, Mapping):
300:                 pairs.extend(params.items())
301:             else:
302:                 pairs.extend(params)
303:             query = urlencode(pairs, doseq=True)
304:         return urlunsplit((final.scheme, final.netloc, final.path, query, ''))

306:     def request(self, method: str, path: str = '', *, params: Any = None, headers: Any = None,
307:                 json: Any = None, data: Any = None, form: Any = None, accept: str | None = None,
308:                 follow_redirects: bool | None = None, timeout: float | None = None,
309:                 max_redirects: int = 5) -> HttpResponse:
310:         current_method = str(method).upper()
311:         if current_method not in ('GET', 'POST', 'PATCH', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'):
312:             raise ValueError('不支持的 HTTP 方法')
313:         body_kinds = (json is not None, data is not None, form is not None)
314:         if sum(1 for flag in body_kinds if flag) > 1:
315:             raise ValueError('json、data 与 form 只能提供一个')
316:         body: bytes | None = None
317:         content_type: str | None = None
318:         if json is not None:
319:             body = _json.dumps(json, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
320:             content_type = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
321:         elif form is not None:
322:             pairs = form.items() if isinstance(form, Mapping) else form
323:             body = urlencode(list(pairs), doseq=True).encode('utf-8')
324:             content_type = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-8'
325:         elif data is not None:
326:             if isinstance(data, str):
327:                 body = data.encode('utf-8')
328:             elif isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
329:                 body = bytes(data)
330:             else:
331:                 raise TypeError('data 必须是 str 或 bytes')
332:         prepared = {str(key): str(value) for key, value in (headers or {}).items()}
333:         for key in prepared:
334:             if key.lower() in ('authorization', 'proxy-authorization'):
335:                 raise ValueError('目标不需要认证，不支持认证头')
336:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'Accept'):
337:             prepared['Accept'] = accept or 'application/json'
338:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'User-Agent'):
339:             prepared['User-Agent'] = 'atlas-acceptance/1.0'
340:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'Accept-Encoding'):
341:             prepared['Accept-Encoding'] = 'identity'
342:         if body is not None and content_type and not _has_header(prepared, 'Content-Type'):
343:             prepared['Content-Type'] = content_type
344:         follow = self.follow_redirects if follow_redirects is None else bool(follow_redirects)
345:         resolved_timeout = self.timeout if timeout is None else float(timeout)
346:         current_url = self._build_url(path, params)
347:         current_body = body
348:         current_headers = prepared
349:         redirects = 0
350:         while True:
351:             request = Request(
352:                 current_url,
353:                 data=current_body if current_method not in ('GET', 'HEAD') else None,
354:                 headers=current_headers,
355:                 method=current_method,
356:             )
357:             started = time.monotonic()
358:             try:
359:                 with self._opener.open(request, timeout=resolved_timeout) as raw:
360:                     status = int(getattr(raw, 'status', raw.getcode()))
361:                     response_headers = raw.headers
362:                     response_body = raw.read()
363:             except HTTPError as exc:
364:                 status = int(exc.code)
365:                 response_headers = exc.headers if exc.headers is not None else {}
366:                 try:
367:                     response_body = exc.read()
368:                 except Exception:
369:                     response_body = b''
370:                 finally:
371:                     try:
372:                         exc.close()
373:                     except Exception:
374:                         pass
375:             except (URLError, HTTPException, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
376:                 reason = getattr(exc, 'reason', exc)
377:                 raise HttpRequestError(
378:                     f'{current_method} {_redact_url(current_url)} 请求失败：{_redact_text(reason, 300)}'
379:                 ) from exc
380:             elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
381:             response = HttpResponse(status, response_headers, response_body, current_method, current_url, elapsed)
382:             if not follow or status not in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
383:                 return response
384:             location = response.location
385:             if not location:
386:                 return response
387:             if redirects >= max_redirects:
388:                 raise HttpRequestError(f'重定向次数超过 {max_redirects}：{_redact_url(current_url)}')
389:             redirects += 1
390:             next_url = urljoin(current_url, location.strip())
391:             try:
392:                 next_origin = _origin(next_url)
393:             except ValueError as exc:
394:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝重定向到无效目标：{_redact_url(next_url)}') from exc
395:             if next_origin != self.origin:
396:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝跨源重定向：{_redact_url(next_url)}')
397:             if status == 303 or (status in (301, 302) and current_method == 'POST'):
398:                 current_method = 'GET'
399:                 current_body = None
400:                 current_headers = {
401:                     key: value for key, value in current_headers.items()
402:                     if key.lower() not in ('content-type', 'content-length')
403:                 }
404:             current_url = next_url

807: def _fit_result(result: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
808:     text = _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
809:     while len(text.encode('utf-8')) > 60000:
810:         changed = False
811:         for item in result['assertions']:
812:             detail = item['detail']
813:             if len(detail) > 40:
814:                 item['detail'] = detail[:max(40, len(detail) // 2)]
815:                 changed = True
816:         if not changed:
817:             for item in result['assertions']:
818:                 if len(item['id']) > 24:
819:                     item['id'] = item['id'][:24]
820:                     changed = True
821:         if not changed:
822:             break
823:         text = _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
824:     while len(text.encode('utf-8')) > 60000 and len(result['assertions']) > 1:
825:         result['assertions'].pop()
826:         text = _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
827:     return text

835:     has_failure = any(not item['passed'] for item in items)
836:     if status is None:

838:     else:

840:             raise ValueError('status 只能是 passed、failed 或 unverified')
841:         final_status = status
842:         if has_failure:

844:         elif not items and final_status == 'passed':
845:             final_status = 'failed'

849:         'status': final_status,
850:         'assertions': items,

853:     payload = (text + chr(10)).encode('utf-8')
854:     buffer = getattr(sys.stdout, 'buffer', None)
855:     if buffer is not None:

857:         buffer.flush()
858:     else:

862:     if failures:

864:         print(f'[atlas] {case_text}: {final_status}; 失败断言: {failure_text}', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
865:     else:
866:         print(f'[atlas] {case_text}: {final_status}; 断言 {len(items)} 条', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

165: class _HtmlReader(HTMLParser):
166:     def __init__(self):
167:         super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
168:         self.doc = _Document()
169:         self._form = None
170:         self._select = None
171:         self._option = None
172:         self._textarea = None
173:         self._anchor = None
174:         self._row = None
175:         self._testid_stack = []
176: 
177:     def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
178:         tag = tag.lower()
179:         attributes = {
180:             str(key).lower(): ('' if value is None else value)
181:             for key, value in attrs
182:         }
183:         self.doc.start_tags.append((tag, attributes))
184:         testid = attributes.get('data-testid') or ''
185:         if testid:
186:             entry = {'tag': tag, 'attrs': attributes, 'text': ''}
187:             self.doc.testids.append(entry)
188:             self._testid_stack.append((tag, entry))
189:         if tag == 'form':
190:             self._finish_form()
191:             self._form = _Form(attributes)
192:         elif tag == 'input':
193:             if self._form is not None:
194:                 self._form.fields.append(_Field(attributes))
195:         elif tag == 'select':
196:             self._finish_select()
197:             if self._form is not None:
198:                 self._select = _Select(attributes)
199:         elif tag == 'option':
200:             self._finish_option()
201:             if self._select is not None:
202:                 self._option = _Option(attributes)
203:         elif tag == 'textarea':
204:             self._finish_textarea()
205:             if self._form is not None:
206:                 self._textarea = _Textarea(attributes)
207:         elif tag == 'a':
208:             self._finish_anchor()
209:             self._anchor = _Anchor(attributes)
210:         elif tag == 'tr' and testid == 'record-row':
211:             self._finish_row()
212:             self._row = _Row(attributes)
213: 
214:     def handle_data(self, data):
215:         if not data:
216:             return
217:         self.doc.text += data
218:         if self._row is not None:
219:             self._row.text += data
220:         if self._anchor is not None:
221:             self._anchor.text += data
222:         if self._option is not None:
223:             self._option.text += data
224:         if self._textarea is not None:
225:             self._textarea.text += data
226:         for _, entry in self._testid_stack:
227:             entry['text'] += data
228: 
229:     def handle_endtag(self, tag):
230:         tag = tag.lower()
231:         if tag == 'a':
232:             self._finish_anchor()
233:         elif tag == 'option':
234:             self._finish_option()
235:         elif tag == 'select':
236:             self._finish_select()
237:         elif tag == 'textarea':
238:             self._finish_textarea()
239:         elif tag == 'form':
240:             self._finish_form()
241:         elif tag == 'tr':
242:             self._finish_row()
243:         if self._testid_stack and self._testid_stack[-1][0] == tag:
244:             self._testid_stack.pop()
245: 
246:     def _finish_option(self):
247:         if self._option is None:
248:             return
249:         option = self._option
250:         self._option = None
251:         if self._select is not None:
252:             self._select.options.append(option)
253: 
254:     def _finish_select(self):
255:         self._finish_option()
256:         if self._select is None:
257:             return
258:         select = self._select
259:         self._select = None
260:         if self._form is not None:
261:             self._form.selects.append(select)
262: 
263:     def _finish_textarea(self):
264:         if self._textarea is None:
265:             return
266:         textarea = self._textarea
267:         self._textarea = None
268:         if self._form is not None:
269:             self._form.textareas.append(textarea)
270: 
271:     def _finish_anchor(self):
272:         if self._anchor is None:
273:             return
274:         anchor = self._anchor
275:         self._anchor = None
276:         self.doc.anchors.append(anchor)
277:         if self._row is not None:
278:             self._row.anchors.append(anchor)
279: 
280:     def _finish_row(self):
281:         if self._row is None:
282:             return
283:         row = self._row
284:         self._row = None
285:         self.doc.rows.append(row)
286: 
287:     def _finish_form(self):
288:         self._finish_select()
289:         self._finish_textarea()
290:         if self._form is None:
291:             return
292:         form = self._form
293:         self._form = None
294:         self.doc.forms.append(form)
295: 
296:     def finalize(self):
297:         self._finish_anchor()
298:         self._finish_row()
299:         self._finish_form()

165: class _HtmlReader(HTMLParser):
166:     def __init__(self):
167:         super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
168:         self.doc = _Document()
169:         self._form = None
170:         self._select = None
171:         self._option = None
172:         self._textarea = None
173:         self._anchor = None
174:         self._row = None
175:         self._testid_stack = []
176: 
177:     def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
178:         tag = tag.lower()
179:         attributes = {
180:             str(key).lower(): ('' if value is None else value)
181:             for key, value in attrs
182:         }
183:         self.doc.start_tags.append((tag, attributes))
184:         testid = attributes.get('data-testid') or ''
185:         if testid:
186:             entry = {'tag': tag, 'attrs': attributes, 'text': ''}
187:             self.doc.testids.append(entry)
188:             self._testid_stack.append((tag, entry))
189:         if tag == 'form':
190:             self._finish_form()
191:             self._form = _Form(attributes)
192:         elif tag == 'input':
193:             if self._form is not None:
194:                 self._form.fields.append(_Field(attributes))
195:         elif tag == 'select':
196:             self._finish_select()
197:             if self._form is not None:
198:                 self._select = _Select(attributes)
199:         elif tag == 'option':
200:             self._finish_option()
201:             if self._select is not None:
202:                 self._option = _Option(attributes)
203:         elif tag == 'textarea':
204:             self._finish_textarea()
205:             if self._form is not None:
206:                 self._textarea = _Textarea(attributes)
207:         elif tag == 'a':
208:             self._finish_anchor()
209:             self._anchor = _Anchor(attributes)
210:         elif tag == 'tr' and testid == 'record-row':
211:             self._finish_row()
212:             self._row = _Row(attributes)
213: 
214:     def handle_data(self, data):
215:         if not data:
216:             return
217:         self.doc.text += data
218:         if self._row is not None:
219:             self._row.text += data
220:         if self._anchor is not None:
221:             self._anchor.text += data
222:         if self._option is not None:
223:             self._option.text += data
224:         if self._textarea is not None:
225:             self._textarea.text += data
226:         for _, entry in self._testid_stack:
227:             entry['text'] += data
228: 
229:     def handle_endtag(self, tag):
230:         tag = tag.lower()
231:         if tag == 'a':
232:             self._finish_anchor()
233:         elif tag == 'option':
234:             self._finish_option()
235:         elif tag == 'select':
236:             self._finish_select()
237:         elif tag == 'textarea':
238:             self._finish_textarea()
239:         elif tag == 'form':
240:             self._finish_form()
241:         elif tag == 'tr':
242:             self._finish_row()
243:         if self._testid_stack and self._testid_stack[-1][0] == tag:
244:             self._testid_stack.pop()
245: 
246:     def _finish_option(self):
247:         if self._option is None:
248:             return
249:         option = self._option
250:         self._option = None
251:         if self._select is not None:
252:             self._select.options.append(option)
253: 
254:     def _finish_select(self):
255:         self._finish_option()
256:         if self._select is None:
257:             return
258:         select = self._select
259:         self._select = None
260:         if self._form is not None:
261:             self._form.selects.append(select)
262: 
263:     def _finish_textarea(self):
264:         if self._textarea is None:
265:             return
266:         textarea = self._textarea
267:         self._textarea = None
268:         if self._form is not None:
269:             self._form.textareas.append(textarea)
270: 
271:     def _finish_anchor(self):
272:         if self._anchor is None:
273:             return
274:         anchor = self._anchor
275:         self._anchor = None
276:         self.doc.anchors.append(anchor)
277:         if self._row is not None:
278:             self._row.anchors.append(anchor)
279: 
280:     def _finish_row(self):
281:         if self._row is None:
282:             return
283:         row = self._row
284:         self._row = None
285:         self.doc.rows.append(row)
286: 
287:     def _finish_form(self):
288:         self._finish_select()
289:         self._finish_textarea()
290:         if self._form is None:
291:             return
292:         form = self._form
293:         self._form = None
294:         self.doc.forms.append(form)
295: 
296:     def finalize(self):
297:         self._finish_anchor()
298:         self._finish_row()
299:         self._finish_form()
300:

306:     reader.finalize()
307:     return reader.doc

179: class _HtmlReader(HTMLParser):
180:     def __init__(self):
181:         super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
182:         self.doc = _Document()
183:         self._form = None
184:         self._select = None
185:         self._option = None
186:         self._textarea = None
187:         self._anchor = None
188:         self._row = None
189:         self._testid_stack = []
190: 
191:     def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
192:         tag = tag.lower()
193:         attributes = {
194:             str(key).lower(): ('' if value is None else value)
195:             for key, value in attrs
196:         }
197:         self.doc.start_tags.append((tag, attributes))
198:         testid = attributes.get('data-testid') or ''
199:         if testid:
200:             entry = {'tag': tag, 'attrs': attributes, 'text': ''}
201:             self.doc.testids.append(entry)
202:             if tag not in _VOID_TAGS:
203:                 self._testid_stack.append((tag, entry))
204:         if tag == 'form':
205:             self._finish_form()
206:             self._form = _Form(attributes)
207:         elif tag == 'input':
208:             if self._form is not None:
209:                 self._form.fields.append(_Field(attributes))
210:         elif tag == 'select':
211:             self._finish_select()
212:             if self._form is not None:
213:                 self._select = _Select(attributes)
214:         elif tag == 'option':
215:             self._finish_option()
216:             if self._select is not None:
217:                 self._option = _Option(attributes)
218:         elif tag == 'textarea':
219:             self._finish_textarea()
220:             if self._form is not None:
221:                 self._textarea = _Textarea(attributes)
222:         elif tag == 'a':
223:             self._finish_anchor()
224:             self._anchor = _Anchor(attributes)
225:         elif tag == 'tr' and testid == 'record-row':
226:             self._finish_row()
227:             self._row = _Row(attributes)
228: 
229:     def handle_data(self, data):
230:         if not data:
231:             return
232:         self.doc.text += data
233:         if self._row is not None:
234:             self._row.text += data
235:         if self._anchor is not None:
236:             self._anchor.text += data
237:         if self._option is not None:
238:             self._option.text += data
239:         if self._textarea is not None:
240:             self._textarea.text += data
241:         for _, entry in self._testid_stack:
242:             entry['text'] += data
243: 
244:     def handle_endtag(self, tag):
245:         tag = tag.lower()
246:         if tag == 'a':
247:             self._finish_anchor()
248:         elif tag == 'option':
249:             self._finish_option()
250:         elif tag == 'select':
251:             self._finish_select()
252:         elif tag == 'textarea':
253:             self._finish_textarea()
254:         elif tag == 'form':
255:             self._finish_form()
256:         elif tag == 'tr':
257:             self._finish_row()
258:         if tag in _VOID_TAGS:
259:             return
260:         if self._testid_stack and self._testid_stack[-1][0] == tag:
261:             self._testid_stack.pop()
262: 
263:     def _finish_option(self):
264:         if self._option is None:
265:             return
266:         option = self._option
267:         self._option = None
268:         if self._select is not None:
269:             self._select.options.append(option)
270: 
271:     def _finish_select(self):
272:         self._finish_option()
273:         if self._select is None:
274:             return
275:         select = self._select
276:         self._select = None
277:         if self._form is not None:
278:             self._form.selects.append(select)
279: 
280:     def _finish_textarea(self):
281:         if self._textarea is None:
282:             return
283:         textarea = self._textarea
284:         self._textarea = None
285:         if self._form is not None:
286:             self._form.textareas.append(textarea)
287: 
288:     def _finish_anchor(self):
289:         if self._anchor is None:
290:             return
291:         anchor = self._anchor
292:         self._anchor = None
293:         self.doc.anchors.append(anchor)
294:         if self._row is not None:
295:             self._row.anchors.append(anchor)
296: 
297:     def _finish_row(self):
298:         if self._row is None:
299:             return
300:         row = self._row
301:         self._row = None
302:         self.doc.rows.append(row)
303: 
304:     def _finish_form(self):
305:         self._finish_select()
306:         self._finish_textarea()
307:         if self._form is None:
308:             return
309:         form = self._form
310:         self._form = None
311:         self.doc.forms.append(form)
312: 
313:     def finalize(self):
314:         self._finish_anchor()
315:         self._finish_row()
316:         self._finish_form()
317:

300: def _action_path(action):
301:     text = (action or '').strip()
302:     if not text:
303:         return ''
304:     try:
305:         path = urlsplit(text).path
306:     except ValueError:
307:         return text
308:     if not path:
309:         return ''
310:     if not path.startswith('/'):
311:         path = '/' + path
312:     return path.rstrip('/') or '/'

319: def _form_fields(form, overrides=None, omit=()):
320:     fields = {}
321:     for field in form.fields:
322:         name = field.name
323:         if not name:
324:             continue
325:         if field.type in ('submit', 'button', 'reset', 'file', 'image'):
326:             continue
327:         if field.type in ('checkbox', 'radio') and not field.checked:
328:             continue
329:         fields[name] = field.value
330:     for select in form.selects:
331:         if select.name:
332:             fields[select.name] = select.selected_value()
333:     for textarea in form.textareas:
334:         if textarea.name:
335:             fields[textarea.name] = textarea.text
336:     for key, value in (overrides or {}).items():
337:         fields[str(key)] = str(value)
338:     for name in omit:
339:         fields.pop(name, None)
340:     return fields

{"path":"acceptance/README.md","replacements":[{"old":"本目录是一套独立、冻结的验收套件，用真实 HTTP 目标验证 python-web 应用。它不包含应用实现，不导入应用代码，也不读取应用自己的测试判定；本文档只是运行说明，不代表任何用例已经执行或通过。","new":"本目录是一套独立、冻结的验收套件，用真实 HTTP 目标验证 python-web 应用。它不包含应用实现，不导入应用代码，也不读取应用自己的测试判定；本文档只是运行说明，不代表任何用例已经执行或通过。**本套件未执行，任何人不得据此声称测试通过。**"},{"old":"### 1.1 `--base-url`

- 示例：`http://127.0.0.1:8000`。必须是 http 或 https；不要包含用户名、口令、查询串或片段。
- 验收目标声明无认证；套件不会把凭据放入 URL、请求头、日志或 fixtures。
- 每个请求都绑定到该精确 origin（scheme、hostname、port），不会放行任意 loopback 主机或端口。","new":"### 1.1 `--base-url`

- 示例：`http://127.0.0.1:8000`。必须是 http 或 https；不得包含用户名、口令、查询串或片段。
- 验收目标声明无认证；套件不会把凭据放入 URL、请求头、日志或 fixtures。`HttpClient` 拒绝 `Authorization`/`Proxy-Authorization`；若目标要求 Basic/Bearer/session 等认证，或健康检查返回 401/403，程序在业务请求前显式失败并报告基础设施未就绪，不支持认证适配器，也不跳过或伪造通过。
- 每个请求都绑定到该精确 origin（scheme、hostname、port）；重定向逐跳校验，跨源立即失败。不会放行任意 loopback 主机或端口，也不默认信任所有 localhost 端口。"},{"old":"## 2. 运行时要求与依赖

- 交付 profile：`python-web`。
- Python 3.12；仅使用标准库（`http.server`、`sqlite3`、`urllib`、`json`、`html.parser` 等）。
- `install` 为空：不执行 `pip`，不访问包索引；`requirements.txt` 声明无第三方包。
- `build` 为空：无 npm、Node、Playwright、浏览器库、前端构建或截图步骤。
- 每个程序用 `os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))` 自举 `sys.path`，不依赖工作目录。下面的示例假定套件位于 `/suite/acceptance`；若实际路径不同，只替换路径，不要改变参数。
- 目标不需要认证；`HttpClient` 不附加全局凭据头，并拒绝 `Authorization`/`Proxy-Authorization`。若目标要求认证（例如健康检查 401/403），程序按基础设施未就绪显式失败，不实现登录适配器，不跳过或伪造通过；错误输出会对 URL 中的凭据和敏感查询参数做脱敏。","new":"## 2. 运行时要求与依赖

- 交付 profile：`python-web`。
- Python 3.12；仅使用标准库（`http.server`、`sqlite3`、`urllib`、`json`、`html.parser` 等）。
- `install` 为空：不执行 `pip`，不访问包索引；`requirements.txt` 声明无第三方包。
- `build` 为空：无 npm、Node、Playwright、浏览器库、前端构建或截图步骤。
- 每个程序用 `os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))` 自举 `sys.path`，不依赖工作目录。下面的示例假定套件位于 `/suite/acceptance`；若实际路径不同，只替换路径，不要改变参数。
- 目标不需要认证，也不实现任何登录/令牌适配器。`HttpClient` 不附加全局凭据头，并拒绝 `Authorization`/`Proxy-Authorization`；目标若返回 401/403 或在健康检查阶段要求认证，程序在发送业务请求前显式失败，按基础设施未就绪处理，不跳过、不伪造通过。错误输出对 URL 中的用户名/口令及敏感查询参数做脱敏，凭据不进入 fixtures、日志或断言 detail。
- 套件只与 `--base-url` 精确 origin 或自己启动的隔离实例通信；外部网络禁用，不抓取已保存 URL、元数据或 favicon。"},{"old":"## 5. 每个用例断言的行为

| 用例 | 行为证据 |
| --- | --- |
| A01 | 先对 base_url 健康检查、保存并读回；再从 app_root 启动隔离实例，保存后停止、以同一实例子目录重启，断言 id 与 url 不变。 |
| A02 | 缺协议、`javascript:`、`ftp://`、无点域名四类 URL 均返回 400 `invalid_url`；以本用例唯一 URL 标记的相对计数断言列表未新增。 |
| A03 | 预置归类（未整理、待购、家居改造、以后看看）可见；缺省 category 落入未整理；新归类名保存后自动创建且可按该归类检索。 |
| A04 | 新建 201/可见、同名及大小写变体 409 `duplicate_category`、PATCH 重命名、DELETE 归类后记录回到未整理；默认归类重命名/删除返回 400 `protected_category`。 |
| A05 | base_url 上移动后仅新归类可见；隔离实例中移动、停止、同子目录重启后归属仍保留。 |
| A06 | 两个归类各两条记录，按归类过滤的结果精确等于本归类集合，且 `/api/categories` 的 count 与实际条数一致。 |
| A07 | 标题、hostname、description 的子串分别命中且大小写不敏感；category 与 q 叠加；无匹配返回 200 空数组。 |
| A08 | `GET /go/{id}` 不跟随重定向，302 的 Location 等于保存 URL；未知 id 返回 404 `not_found`；读回 URL 未被改写。 |
| A09 | base_url 删除后默认列表排除、`include_trashed=1` 可见、restore 后 url/title/description/category 恢复；隔离实例删除跨重启保持。 |
| A10 | 未知 id 的 GET/PATCH/DELETE/move 均 404 `not_found`；三类畸形 JSON 均 400 `bad_request`；无 5xx，记录集合与锚点字段不变。 |
| A11 | `/api/health` 返回 200 JSON；`GET /` 返回 200 text/html，含 `action=/bookmarks/new` 表单、`name=url` 字段与列表容器。 |
| A12 | 空名与 121 字符归类名的保存/移动均 400 `invalid_category`；归类集合、记录集合与锚点归属不变。 |
| A13 | 仅凭 URL 保存 201；hostname 由 URL 派生，title 允许缺失或字符串降级，favicon 缺失/内联/同源；首页可渲染记录且 HTML 资源引用不含外部 URL。 |
| A14 | `GET /api/export` 返回 200 text/html，含 Netscape 书签头与两条已存 URL；在 data_dir 生成导入 HTML，POST `/api/import` 返回 imported=2/skipped=0，导入 URL 可检索。 |
| A15 | 重复 URL 返回 409 `duplicate_url` 且含 existing_id，总数不变；`allow_duplicate=true` 时 201、新 id、总数加一、同 URL 两条。 |","new":"## 5. 每个用例断言的行为

| 用例 | 行为证据 |
| --- | --- |
| A01 | 对 base_url 做健康检查，经真实保存表单提交唯一 URL/标题/描述并跟随 303，断言 HTML 记录行与 JSON 读回；再用 `--app-root`/`--data-dir` 启动隔离实例，经真实表单保存，停止后以同一实例子目录重启，断言 id、原始 URL、标题与描述稳定。 |
| A02 | 用保存表单提交单标签主机 URL（如 `http://atlas-a02-<token>`）作为显式正向边界：断言 303、原始字符串持久化且行内 href 精确；同一表单与 JSON 分别提交缺协议、`javascript:`、`ftp://`、`http://` 空主机、含空格/非法 hostname 的值，断言 400 `invalid_url`、`form-error` 可读、相对计数不新增且被拒 URL 不出现在列表。单标签主机是接受策略，不要求点域名。 |
| A03 | 预置归类（未整理、待购、家居改造、以后看看）在 HTML 与 API 可见；真实表单省略 category 保存落入未整理；表单输入新归类名保存后自动创建，并可按该归类筛选。 |
| A04 | 从首页 `a[data-testid=category-manager]` 进入 `/categories`；用 `category-create-form` 的真实 `name` 新建（303 后可见且计数正确）；用重名及大小写变体提交 create/rename 表单，断言 409 `duplicate_category`、`form-error`、输入保留且集合不变；用 `category-rename-form` 提交 `category_id`+`name` 重命名，记录跟随；用 `category-delete-form` 删除归类，断言活动与软删记录都迁回未整理、软删记录在 `/?trash=1` 可恢复；对默认归类做 rename/delete，断言 400 `protected_category` 且不变；同时保留 JSON API 的同等断言。create/rename 分别提交省略 name、空字符串、纯空白、121 字符名（JSON 另含显式 null），均断言 400 `invalid_name`、`form-error`、提交值保留、分类与记录集合及归属不变。 |
| A05 | 用 `record-move-form` 的真实 `record_id` 与 `select name=category_id` 移动，303 到目标归类后旧归类消失、新归类可见、JSON 读回归类正确；再用 `--app-root`/`--data-dir` 启动隔离实例，经真实表单移动，停止后同目录重启读回归属。 |
| A06 | 两个归类各两条记录，读取 HTML `[data-testid=category-count][data-category-id]` 与记录行，并与 `/api/categories` 的 count 和 `/api/bookmarks` 列表比对；通过真实移动、删除、恢复表单改变状态，逐步断言 count 只计活动记录且与列表一致，软删记录仍在 `include_trashed=1` 中。 |
